title: A multi-catch union retains a dead exception type that is never thrown in the try block

ground_truth.statement: loadCount() only throws MissingItemException and never throws StaleStateException, so StaleStateException in the multi-catch clause can never match any thrown exception.

notes: mago.toml explicitly enables check-throws = true and check-dead-catch = true. Even with dead-catch checking enabled, Mago 1.60.2 stays silent because another union member (MissingItemException) is thrown, whereas PHPStan 2.3.1 reports catch.neverThrown for StaleStateException. Psalm 6.20.1 lacks dead-catch checking.
